column1: #Text=Can you describe the content of this map?
#Text=Map of a region of the United States of America with the city of Madison located between two lakes, Lake Mendota to the north and Lake Monona to the south.
#Text=Further south, part of a third lake can be seen.
#Text=Surrounding Lake Mendota are three medium-sized cities: Shorewood Hills, Middleton, and Maple Bluff.
#Text=On the eastern shore of Lake Monona is the city of Monona.
#Text=Major highways are numbered, with one running east to west between Lake Monona and the southernmost lake (Route 18).
#Text=Three major north-south highways, one passing through the city of Madison between Lake Mendota and Lake Monona and the other two east of the lakes (151, 51, and 90).
#Text=A large airport northeast of Lake Mendota.
#Text=A hotel marked in pink in Monona.
#Text=A botanical garden, hiking trails, a nature area to the south (Lewis Nine Springs) next to a farm park, a national park to the north, not far from a monastery.
#Text=In the northeast corner, along Route 151, you can see the location of a large hospital, Madison Hospital.
